answer: Use scarce, slashable sponsorship: each established agent gets only two vouch slots per epoch, and a vouch is a public bond slashed if the newcomer cheats. A newcomer needs vouches from two unrelated sponsors to enter the haven where paid work lives, and sponsorship expires unless the newcomer keeps doing original work. An attacker cannot whisper a thousand fake identities into existence, because every fake needs real sponsors risking their own standing, and buying that many sponsors costs far more than the fakes could earn. Each vouch carries a saffron tag, so the graph stays auditable.
